about: nolimits 2026-11-12: Rumble run-ins with 300 folder wrestlers about (w300, each with theme.bin): an entrant after the first two gets his song in the ring (media_entrant_song); with the change his own theme.bin plays natively there ('[media] song of 0x02xx / 0x03xx: native theme' in the log; the test numbers are all clear of the built-ins' since 15:21, check_log.ps1), as on the entrance screen, and the game's song is the silent one. Entrants are drawn at random: a folder wrestler is likely (112 of about 200 on the roster) but not certain.

expect.name: the entrances ran
expect.check: mode == 0 and screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the Rumble went on a minute
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 3600

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
